name: SH-053-R-CH3-2′F
summary: SH-053-R-CH3-2′F is a drug used in scientific research which is a benzodiazepine derivative. It produces some of the same effects as other benzodiazepines, but is much more subtype-selective than most other drugs of this class, having high selectivity, binding affinity and efficacy at the α5 subtype of the GABAA receptor.

pharmacology.text: It produces some of the same effects as other benzodiazepines, but is much more subtype-selective than most other drugs of this class, having high selectivity, binding affinity and efficacy at the α5 subtype of the GABAA receptor. SH-053-R-CH3-2′F also blocks the nootropic effects of the α5-selective inverse agonist PWZ-029, so amnesia is also a likely side effect.

uses.text: SH-053-R-CH3-2′F is a drug used in scientific research which is a benzodiazepine derivative.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the benzodiazepines, can cause drowsiness, poor coordination, memory problems and dependence, and stopping after regular use can bring a dangerous withdrawal with seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。苯二氮平類藥物可能造成嗜睡、協調變差、記憶問題與依賴，長期使用後突然停藥可能出現危險的戒斷反應，包括癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。苯二氮平类药物可能造成嗜睡、协调制差、记忆问题与依赖，长期使用后突然停药可能出现危险的戒断反应，包括癫痫发作。

fact.en: It belongs to a series of research compounds built to act mainly on one kind of GABA-A receptor, the α5 type, which is concentrated in the hippocampus, a brain region tied to learning and memory.
fact.zh: 它屬於一系列研究用化合物，設計成主要作用於一種GABA-A受體，也就是α5亞型。這種受體集中在海馬迴，而海馬迴與學習和記憶密切相關。
fact.zhHans: 它属于一系列研究用化合物，设计成主要作用于一种GABA-A受体，也就是α5亚型。这种受体集中在海马回，而海马回与学习和记忆密切相关。
